title: 高二短对话：外套与图注
source_notice: 高二银川标题公开阶段卷五短对话两遍/末尾十秒已核，不移借高一单遍。源录音/脚本/听力键缺，后文阅读1—5答案不能移作听力键；原校身份未认证。本稿完整原创配套非来源gold或独立难度验证。
instruction: 听五段独立短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听后留10秒。本机可重播供审阅，不作正式次数控制。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That jacket looks expensive. Was it in the sale?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No, it was my father's. I had the lining replaced and the sleeves shortened. It cost less than buying a new one.

questions.stem: What did the woman do with the jacket?
options: She bought it in a sale.
She gave it to her father.
She had an old one altered.
questions.rationale: A：明确不是折扣买；B：原属父亲不是送父亲；C：换衬里、改袖长翻修改衣

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The caption says this is the 1928 flood. Are you sure?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The photographer's notebook dates it to 1931. I trusted the label on the envelope at first, but the notebook is clearer evidence.

questions.stem: What will the man probably change?
questions.rationale: A：新证据纠正日期；B：未质疑拍摄者身份；C：未修改颜色

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Do you want me to carry the boxes to the car?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Leave them here for now. The buyer has asked to collect them tomorrow instead. Could you check that the lids are secure?

questions.stem: What does the woman ask the man to do now?
questions.rationale: A：暂时留在原处；B：明确检查箱盖牢固；C：买家已更改收货无打电话要求

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I cannot believe you turned down the lead role.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The play is excellent, but rehearsals would take every evening. I have already committed to helping at the youth centre twice a week.

questions.stem: Why did the man refuse the role?
questions.rationale: A：认为戏很好；B：未说表演不足；C：排练与每周两次志愿安排冲突

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You sounded unconvinced by the proposal at first.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I was. But seeing a working model answered most of my doubts. I would like to see the cost figures before I give it my full support.

questions.stem: How does the woman feel about the proposal now?
options: More positive, with one concern remaining.
questions.rationale: A：实物消除多数疑虑但仍等成本；B：未完全支持；C：比最初更积极非更消极
